terra.problem: The group-chat comparison has nobody sending a message, but the people are speaking to one another. The joke reverses the action in the passage.
The passage does not identify Absalom as David’s son. That fact needs an outside reference.
Calling Amasa’s appointment a promotion adds a detail the text does not establish. He had already commanded Absalom’s army.
“Two words” does not match the message just quoted, which has six words.
The text does not say Judah sent its reply right away.
“Had just sent word” adds a time detail the text does not give.
Calling Amasa’s appointment a promotion adds a detail the text does not establish.
The text says the thousand men came along with Shimei, not that they arrived behind him.
“He brought a whole crowd” suggests Shimei was responsible for bringing the men. The text says they came along with him.
The joke says Ziba carried the people to the river, but nothing sets up that image. It does not pass the joke logic test.
Shimei admits that he sinned and refers to his wrongdoing, but he does not name the specific wrongdoing himself.
The text says David sent a message to the priests, but it does not say they carried it.
